118226.name: Chabad of Fort Lee
118226.note: Its own About page: 'In the summer of 1996, Rabbi Meir and Lieba Konikov came to Fort Lee with a heartfelt mission'. Rabbi Mendel and Chaya Wuensch joined in the summer of 2019.

118402.name: Chabad of the Windsors
118402.note: Its own About page ('About Chabad of the Windsors'): 'We opened in June of 2000 and are inspired by the teachings of the Lubavitcher Rebbe'. Rabbi Sholom and Aliza Leverton.

539165.name: Chabad @ TCNJ
539165.note: Lubavitch.com (from the New Jersey Jewish News), 10 May 2005 ('Chabad at the College of New Jersey in Ewing'): 'Since its launch last fall, Chabad of TCNJ has offered students a Thursday-evening class', under Rabbi Dovid Dubov, director of Chabad Lubavitch of Greater Mercer County. Today Rabbi Akiva and Zeesy Greenbaum direct it.

878203.name: Chabad Center for Jewish Life - Mountain Lakes | Boonton | Denville
878203.note: Its own Welcome page: 'The Chabad Center for Jewish Life was founded in 2009 by Rabbi Levi Dubinsky and Rivky Dubinsky', serving Mountain Lakes, Boonton and Denville.

3909147.name: Chabad of Englewood
3909147.note: Its own site: 'Rabbi Shmuel and Didi Konikov moved to Englewood in the summer of 2018' to establish it. IRS (ProPublica): Chabad of Englewood Inc, exempt from Oct 2019.

4427531.name: Chabad of Hasbrouck Heights
4427531.note: Its own site: 'Chabad of Hasbrouck Heights was established in April 2019 by Rabbi Shlomie and Mushkie Segelman, together with their beautiful children.'

5803940.name: Chabad of Mendham and Chester
5803940.note: Its own site: 'Chabad of Mendham and Chester was established at the start of 2023 and is directed by Rabbi Ari and Sarah Herson.' (Its About page: 5907070.)

117998.name: Lubavitch on the Palisades
117998.note: IRS (ProPublica): Lubavitch On The Palisades, 11 Harold St, Tenafly, exempt from March 1996, so it existed by then. The Jewish Standard (CrownHeights.info, 15 Sept 2006): 'The center's current sanctuary, built nine years ago' (about 1997); The Record (CrownHeights.info, 6 July 2011): 'Seven times in the past 14 years, the center has filed applications before city boards to expand its Harold Street quarters'. Its own site's About page has a 'Celebrating 25 Years' heading, undated. When Rabbi Mordechai and Malkie Shain began is not stated.

924164.name: Chabad-Lubavitch of Morganville
924164.note: Hamodia (COLlive, 6 May 2011): of Chabad of West Monmouth County's four further centers, 'Chabad of Morganville, under the direction of Rabbi Levi and Mrs. Chanale Wolosow'. So there by 2011; its start not found. Rabbi Levi Wolosow, also Chabad of Western Monmouth County's adult education director, died in Feb 2025. Lead: its chabad.org listing (924164) is from about 2009.

1110855.name: Friendship Circle of Greater Mercer County
1110855.note: IRS (ProPublica): Friendship Circle Of Greater Mercer County A Nj Nonprofit Corporation, Princeton, exempt from Dec 2012, so it existed by then; its start not found. Rabbi Shmuel Dovid and Mushky Wilhelm. Lead: its chabad.org listing (1110855) is from about 2010.
